niche_description: TikTok short videos in which a single creator demonstrates and explains exactly one resistance or bodyweight exercise (setup, execution cues, common mistakes). Not workout routines, programs, motivation, memes, or product hard-sell content.
language_policy: English spoken, captioned, or text-overlaid; any accent/dialect; non-English audio with English subtitles accepted.
geographic_constraints: None beyond language; any country of origin.
publication_window_policy: Published within the 12 months preceding pilot collection start; exact window dates recorded when sampling begins. Videos younger than 14 days flagged immature_observation.

commercial_content_policy.rules: Affiliate/bio-link commerciality permitted and must be flagged per source. In-video soft promotion of own program/app allowed if flagged. Hard product sell (discount codes, supplement close-ups) excluded.

creator_inclusion_rules: Creator account's primary content theme is fitness/strength training (verified by spot-check of recent grid)
Not a comedy, aggregation, or compilation page
format_inclusion_rules: Demonstrates exactly one exercise as primary content
Filmed primarily in a gym/home-gym or equivalent training context
exclusion_rules: Multi-exercise routines, full workouts, program pitches, pure talking-head/motivation content
In-video hard product sell (discount codes read aloud, branded product close-ups as primary subject)
Dance trends, memes, music/performance content using an exercise as backdrop
Sexualized framing where exercise demonstration is secondary
Compilation/reaction videos of other creators' clips
Re-uploads of another creator's video (recorded with duplicate_of note)

duplicate_policy.near_duplicate_rule: Same exercise plus substantially identical script/shot list counts as a creative duplicate; keep the earliest-published instance only.

pilot_sampling_policy.stratification: roughly equal thirds by observed views at collection time relative to pool typical range

version_change_triggers: Platform change or second platform addition
Niche redefinition (requires a new cohort_id entirely)
